genius_advantages.point: TransAct's FY2025 10-K names its direct competitors for the BOHA! foodservice/food-safety platform as Crunchtime Information Systems (including its Zenput and Squadle brands), Digi International, Avery Dennison, Ecolab, ITD Food Safety, Daymark Safety Systems, Integrated Control Corp, and Toast, Inc.

latest_cos_commentary.headline: TransAct Technologies (Nasdaq: TACT) is a public company whose BOHA! platform targets back-of-house food-safety, labeling, and kitchen compliance for restaurants and foodservice operators, alongside a legacy casino/gaming printing business.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Overlaps with Genius's back_office and kitchen_drive_thru lines specifically around food-safety compliance and kitchen printing/labeling, not core POS or payments.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: FY2025 10-K filed March 12, 2026 names Toast, Crunchtime/Zenput/Squadle, and several food-safety specialists as its direct BOHA! competitors — useful to know which battles TransAct is actually fighting.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Recognize that TransAct's BOHA! is a niche back-of-house/food-safety tool, not a full POS or payments competitor; relevant mainly where a prospect already runs BOHA! for kitchen compliance.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No named restaurant customers or segment-level revenue for BOHA! were disclosed in the section of the 10-K reviewed.

verification_needed: Total FY2025 revenue and BOHA! segment revenue breakdown (not disclosed in the 10-K section reviewed)
